        matrix res;
        memset(res.mat,0,sizeof(res.mat));
        for (int i=0;i<=m;++i){
            for (int j=0;j<=m;++j){
                for (int k=0;k<=m;++k){
                    res.mat[i][j]=(res.mat[i][j]+mat[i][k]*a.mat[k][j])%mod;
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    int x=0,f=1;
    char ch=getchar();
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9'){
        if (ch=='-') f=-1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9'){
        x=x*10+ch-'0';ch=getchar();
    }
    return x*f;
